dedupe_keys.name: vsb partial discharge signal inspection tools

description: The VSB partial-discharge research team publishes Python scripts for inspecting antenna-based power-line monitoring data. The README documents checks of randomly selected faults, station-level samples and monthly measurements, together with utilities for loading data, calculating metrics and plotting. Another script identifies continuous acquisition intervals, and a shell helper decompresses the separately supplied archives. Source access is free under MIT. The documented data cover Czech and Slovak monitoring stations, while the scripts operate on whichever compatible station files the user selects. They can prepare fault-detection benchmarks for asset-condition simulations considered alongside platform-opendss. A caveat is that the repository does not contain the signal dataset and its sampling scripts are not a full operational protection system. Random subsampling can also affect reported metrics. The README and file identities were inspected, but no data were decompressed and no scripts were run.
